SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION - SALEM COUNTY
DOCKET NO.
F-010350-25
SHERIFF NO.
26000150
PLAINTIFF -
NewRez LLC d/b/a Shellpoint Mortgage Servicing
DEFENDANT -
Gideon Alexander; Mrs./Mr. Alexander, spouse or civil union partner of Gideon Alexander; United State of America; Solaris Assets LLC s/b/m/t Sunnova SLA Management LLC
By virtue of a Writ of Execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public venue at the Salem County Courthouse, situated at No. 92 Market Street, in the City of Salem, New Jersey on
Monday,
September 14, 2026
at
2 o’clock
in the afternoon, ALL the following lot, tract or parcel of land and premises, situate, lying and being in the Township of Elsinboro, in the County of Salem and State of New Jersey, bounded and described as follows:
Municipality: Elsinboro
County of Salem
State of New Jersey
Street and Street No.: 432 Walnut Street Salem, NJ 08079
Tax Block and Lot No.: Block 34, Lot 32.01
Dimensions of Lot (approximately): 212.26ft x 150.00ft x 154.52ft x 27.00ft x 153.11ft
Nearest Cross Street: Approximately 125.46ft to nearest cross street known as Hagersville Road
A full legal description can be found in the Office of the Clerk of Salem County in Deed Book 4631 at Page 459.
The approximate amount of the judgment to be satisfied by said sale is the sum of $226,645.36 together with the costs of this sale.
The approximate upset price is $243,645.24.
The upset price may be subject to further Orders of additional sums.
Occupancy Status: Owner Occupied
Pursuant to a municipal Tax Search dated May 7, 2026
Subject to: 2026 2nd quarter taxes due 5/1/2026, $1,408.37 OPEN
2026 3rd quarter taxes due 8/1/2026, TO BE DETERMINED
Terms of Sale: 20% of bid in cash, certified check or cashiers check from the successful bidder upon conclusion of sale. The Sheriff’s Office cash limit is $1,000.00 The balance is due within 30 days of the date of sale.
Surplus Money:
If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to the Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person’s claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The Sheriff reserves the right to adjourn the sale without further notice through publication.
Hill Wallack LLP
, Attorneys for Plaintiff
Charles M. Miller, Sheriff
